title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 13:59:53 最新章节：第二百三十七章 狭隘了云宗主
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
靖宇三年，国泰民安。
腐朽前朝已覆，乱世烽烟尽散。这片浸透血泪的土地，历经多年战火后终于归于宁静，百姓得以休养生息，安居乐业。
东海之滨，天光炽烈，波涛滚滚一次次扑向岸边的礁石，撞出雪白的浪沫，又簌簌退去。
明媚的阳光洒落在张张笑颜之上。孩童嬉戏追逐，恣意奔跑；渔民们坐在沙滩上，一边收拾渔获、整理网具，一边谈笑风生，享受着这太平盛世中难得的安闲。
忽然，
“呜——呜——”
远方传来低沉而巨大的鸣响，穿透海风，引得众人纷纷抬头，朝同一方向望去，眼仁骤然放大。
只见巨大阴影遮天蔽日，白色蒸汽直冲云霄，风帆张扬，玄底赤龙旗帜在风中猎猎飞扬，庞然大物碾着波涛，携着一股子一往无前的气势，朝那浩瀚无边际的无尽之海冲去。
良久，直至船影渐远，众人才回神来，回归的生活，只是眼中的震撼久久未散。
“好大的船……真是前所未见！”
“真威风！还喷着气呢！这般巨物，该有多重？恐怕能载上万人吧？”
“何止！听说这叫‘神武号’，是当今圣上亲自督造的神船！”
“陛下所造之物，果然非同凡响……只是造如此大船，是要做什么？”
“陛下何等人物？雄才大略一统天下，现在自是要出海去扩张领土，扬我大夏国威啊！”
“不不不……传言无尽之海的尽头是智慧彼岸，仙人居所，我猜陛下是派船出去，寻仙问药，求得不死永寿呢！”
“真能不死吗……要是咱们陛下真能永寿就好了……我还想接着过这太平日子……”
……
那些庙堂之高、天下大事，离这些海滨庶民终究遥远，却不妨碍他们津津乐道，揣测纷纷。
他们或许一生离不开这片海滩，能亲眼得见这般盛景，已是生平大幸。今日所见，他们还要回家去说与亲友听呢！
然而话音未落，议论声却戛然而止。

其中一人忽地瞪圆双眼，指向远海，瞳孔骤缩，满脸难以置信，声音也磕绊起来：“那……那是什么东西？”
“还能是什么……老刘你也太大惊小怪了，不就是陛下的神武号嘛……”
对面的渔民不以为意地撇撇嘴，同样的景象见过两次，已不再震撼。他随口应着，转头顺着对方所指的方向望去。
下一瞬，却如遭雷击般僵在原地，张大了嘴，半晌才挤出声音：“这……这怎么可能？！”
目光所及，在那威风凛凛，踏浪前行的神武号穹顶，风云忽变。道道无形的波纹在空中荡开，仿佛有奇诡之力弥漫扩散。紧接着，一物自虚空中缓缓探出轮廓，由小变大，逐渐清晰……竟是一艘木船，静静悬浮于半空之中。
那船样式古旧，比之神武号的宏伟显得简朴许多，体量也远不能及。可是……它竟是浮在空中的！
渔民们不自觉地舔了舔发干的嘴唇，声音发颤：“这……这也是陛下造的？”
content_en:
In the third year of Jingyu, the country is peaceful and the people are safe.
The decadent previous dynasty has been overthrown, and the wars of troubled times have dispersed. This land soaked in blood and tears finally returned to peace after years of war, and the people were able to recuperate and live and work in peace and contentment.
On the shore of the East China Sea, the sky is blazing, and the rolling waves rush to the rocks on the shore again and again, hitting the snow-white foam and then retreating.
The bright sunshine shines on Zhang Zhang's smiling face. Children were playing, chasing and running freely; fishermen were sitting on the beach, gathering their catches and arranging their nets, talking and laughing, enjoying the rare leisure in this peaceful and prosperous age.
suddenly,
"Woo--Woo--"
A low and loud sound came from the distance, penetrating the sea breeze, causing everyone to raise their heads and look in the same direction, their eyes suddenly widening.
I saw huge shadows covering the sky and blocking out the sun, white steam rising straight into the sky, sails fluttering, black-bottomed red dragon flags flying in the wind, the giant beast crushing the waves, rushing towards the vast and boundless sea with an indomitable momentum.
It took a long time until the shadow of the boat faded away before everyone came back to their senses and returned to life, but the shock in their eyes lingered for a long time.
"What a big ship... I've never seen it before!"
"It's so majestic! It's still breathing! How much does such a giant thing weigh? I'm afraid it can carry tens of thousands of people, right?"
"More than that! I heard that this is called the 'Shenwu', and it is a divine ship built under the supervision of the current Holy Emperor himself!"
"What your Majesty has built is indeed extraordinary...but what is the purpose of building such a big ship?"
"What kind of person is Your Majesty? Your talents have unified the world, and now you have to go to sea to expand your territory and show off the prestige of our country, Great Xia!"
"No, no, no...it is rumored that at the end of the Endless Sea is the shore of wisdom, where immortals live. I guess His Majesty sent a ship out to search for immortals and medicine to seek immortality and eternal life!"
"Can I really not die... It would be great if our Majesty could really live forever... I still want to continue living this peaceful life..."
…
The heights of these temples and the great events of the world are ultimately far away from the common people on the seaside, but it does not prevent them from talking about them and speculating about them.
They may never be able to leave this beach in their lives, and it is a great blessing to be able to see such a magnificent scene with their own eyes. What I saw today is that they still want to go home and talk to their relatives and friends!
However, before he finished speaking, the discussion stopped abruptly.
One of them suddenly widened his eyes and pointed to the distant sea, his pupils shrank suddenly, his face was full of disbelief, and his voice was stumbling: "Then... what is that thing?"
"What else could it be...Old Liu, you are making too much fuss. Isn't it just His Majesty's Shenwu No...."
The fisherman opposite curled his lips indifferently. Having seen the same scene twice, he was no longer shocked. He responded casually and turned his head to look in the direction pointed by the other party.
The next moment, he froze in place as if struck by lightning, opened his mouth wide, and finally managed to squeeze out a voice: "This... how is this possible?!"
As far as the eye can see, on the dome of the Shenwu, which is majestic and riding the waves, the situation changes suddenly. Invisible ripples swayed in the air, as if there was a strange force spreading throughout the air. Immediately afterwards, the outline of an object slowly emerged from the void, growing from small to large, and gradually became clearer... It turned out to be a wooden boat, quietly suspended in mid-air.
The ship was of an old style, much simpler than the grandeur of the Shenwu, and its size was far inferior. But...it actually floats in the air!
The fishermen licked their dry lips unconsciously, and their voices trembled: "This...is this also made by your majesty?"
